flags.item: Komplettligaen removed Solid Gaming mid-split - the affected cards stay unresolved
flags.detail: Leaguepedia's Data:Komplettligaen/2026 Season/Autumn Split template records '|dqteams=Solid Gaming' ('removed from the league in Round 10; remaining matches forfeited 0-1'). Four Solid Gaming cards are still on Hotspawn's list in this snapshot and every one of them is quarantined to Unresolved rather than picking a disqualified team: #1071170 vs VES Japan, #1071200 vs Playwell Rod Q, #1071186 vs NTNUI Kometkameratene and #1071206 (Volda E-Sport listed first). Fixture #1071216 (Solid Gaming vs DMG Esports Norway), which earlier reports on this page described, is no longer in the list, so it is recorded here as history, not as an open card. If Hotspawn settles these as walkovers rather than voiding them, the active opponent receives the default win. flags.item: Historical example: Galions vs Solary (#1081205) crowd split diverged +33.8 pp from the market consensus
flags.detail: Recorded 2026-10-21 while that EMEA Masters Summer 2026 Final was listed. Across Pinnacle, Kalshi CFTC, Polymarket full-series CLOB, Bovada and a specialist esportsbook the match was priced near-even at 52.2% / 47.8% while Hotspawn's crowd sat at 86% / 14% - the reason crowd pick share is never a probability input here. The fixture has since left Hotspawn's list, so this is kept as history and is not counted in any current coverage figure. flags.item: Symmetric 1.80 / 1.80 aggregator placeholder rejected on the LCP 2027 Promotion card (#1081423)
flags.detail: On 2026-10-23 the EGamersWorld match page for Ground Zero Gaming vs Frank Esports published a symmetric 1.80 / 1.80 pair (its 'no price' default) while the same site's listing row showed 1.025 / 10.5. A build-time quote that cannot be reproduced from the source page is not evidence, so the pipeline rejects symmetric 1.80 / 1.80 placeholders and the archived 1.025 / 10.5 reading is excluded from corroboration - both readings are published on External line coverage. The earlier Turkish Academy League example quoted in this slot referred to fixture #1079080, which now belongs to a different match (Mental Rush vs Vitality Rising Bees) and is therefore withdrawn.

flags.item: Historical: 4 Nations Week 1 overturned forfeits for Team Reds were applied to the ratings
flags.detail: Team Reds originally won two Week 1 series in 4 Nations 2026 Halloween Heist; both were overturned to 0-1 administrative forfeits for fielding an ineligible roster. The model consumes the official post-ruling series records. The team now appears in Arabian League 2nd Division 2026 Summer on the current list; this note is kept for the ratings audit and is not a claim about a live card.

flags.item: Hotspawn displays the wrong name for the PvB slot in PRM 2nd Division
flags.detail: Hotspawn labels this team 'Phong Vũ Buffalo', but the five fixtures attributed to it (27 Oct 17:00 vs DKB XPERION NXT, 30 Oct 19:30 vs VfB eSports, 3 Nov 17:00 vs 404 Multigaming, 8 Nov 18:30 vs MT1 Esports, 13 Nov 18:30 vs regnum4games) are, in Leaguepedia, the five fixtures of 'PvB (Swiss Team)' in Prime League 2nd Division/2027 Season/Fall Split - same dates, same kick-off times, same opponents. The alias is therefore recorded explicitly in data/aliases.json with this evidence, not guessed. Hotspawn's card for these matches still shows the Vietnamese name and no logo.

flags.item: Hotspawn's tier field is 'waiting for information' (or empty) for most non-featured LoL matches
flags.detail: The fixtures API frequently returns tier='waiting for information' or null and leaves stage empty, so tier is reproduced verbatim and never inferred from the league name. The live number is on Verification (method counts) and External line coverage (per competition).

flags.item: Only the international events carry real bookmaker lines; every national and academy league is originated
flags.detail: Matches priced from real money come only from the international events (in this snapshot the World Championship Main Event, LGC Rising Playoffs and LCP 2027 Promotion) via a precision-weighted consensus of Pinnacle, Polymarket, Kalshi CFTC, Bovada and a verified esportsbook quote. Tier-B/C/D national leagues have no published bookmaker market that we can reach, so their lines are originated from recorded series history. The live per-competition split, the captured receipts and the evidence that no book prices the rest are on External line coverage; no fixed count is quoted here because it changes every refresh.

flags.item: Leaguepedia is a community wiki, not a Riot Games property
flags.detail: Series results for the Elo model come from Leaguepedia's Cargo export (volunteer-maintained, the de-facto LoL esports results database). Riot's official LoL Esports API is used as a cross-check for the World Championship schedule only, because it does not publish these national leagues.

flags.item: Elo ratings are only comparable inside one opponent graph
flags.detail: Ratings are fitted per league network. A team that never played a common opponent with its fixture opponent cannot be compared meaningfully; those matches are marked provisional with the 'no shared-opponent chain' note.

flags.item: List horizon extends past the 7-day pick'em window
flags.detail: Hotspawn lists fixtures up to mid-November (the PRM 3rd Division round on 2026-11-15), beyond the current weekly reset. All listed fixtures are kept so coverage matches the site exactly.

flags.item: Hotspawn community pick percentages are stored but never used
flags.detail: The fixtures API exposes participants*_picked_percent. These values are persisted in data/raw/hotspawn_lol.json for transparency and are not read by the model, the picks, or any probability on the site.

flags.item: 12 team names needed a non-exact Leaguepedia match
flags.detail: Leaguepedia appends a region to duplicate team names (e.g. 'Fenrir (Icelandic Team)'). Every non-exact join and its evidence is listed on the Verification page; ambiguous names are left unmatched instead of guessed.

flags.item: 65 fixtures still listed as 'scheduled' although their start time has passed
flags.detail: Hotspawn's fixtures API returns status='scheduled' for these cards even though the published start time is more than three hours in the past (earliest 2026-08-26T17:00:00Z). They are kept in the list to mirror Hotspawn exactly, marked 'start time passed' on the card, and sorted after upcoming matches. Most likely postponed or awaiting a result.

Pinnacle prices the World Championship and EMEA Masters fixtures from this list. The remaining national and academy leagues have no published market on any book reachable from the runner, which is why their lines are originated by our own model.
